name: com.gameframex.unity.getchannel
description:
GameFrameX GetChannel — cross-platform distribution channel identifier package. Reads the application's channel at runtime from platform-specific sources: Android reads AndroidManifest meta-data, iOS reads Info.plist via P/Invoke, and Editor/PC builds read a config file under Resources. Lets the same build report different distribution channels without code changes. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX GetChannel — 跨平台分发渠道标识功能包。在运行时从平台特定来源读取应用的渠道号：Android 读取 AndroidManifest meta-data，iOS 通过 P/Invoke 读取 Info.plist，Editor/PC 从 Resources 下的配置文件读取。使同一构建无需改代码即可区分不同分发渠道。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
